kpis.name: Annual Congress Attendance
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress held in Frankfurt from May 15-17, 2024.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual Congress held in Frankfurt from May 15 to 17 brought together 225 participants from 11 European countries.

kpis.name: Member Countries Represented

kpis.description: At the 2024 Congress, participants came from 11 different European countries, reflecting IVR's pan-European reach.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024.
kpis.description: The first edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024 gathered approximately 80 participants from the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany.

kpis.name: ZKR Labor Market Workshop Participation
kpis.explanation: Active participation in international working groups and committee meetings related to inland shipping standards and labor market issues.
kpis.description: IVR actively participated in several working group meetings and CESNI committee sessions in 2024, including the March 14, 2024 workshop on the labor market in inland navigation and CESNI sessions on April 11 and October 17, 2024.
